licence_basis.reason: Author Aleksander Brückner (1856–1939) died in 1939 (Wielkopolska Biblioteka Cyfrowa, which marks its scan of the 1927 edition, publication 510848, "Prawa: domena publiczna"). Economic rights expire 70 years after the author's death, counted from the end of that year (Polish Copyright Act, art. 36), so the work has been in the public domain since 2010-01-01. The text was read from the page images of Internet Archive item slownik_etymologiczny_jezyka_polskiego (licence URL: CC0 1.0), the same copy as the owner's package (docs/sources/bruckner-buryan-package.md).
